steps.title: IF you have followed all the …
steps.text: IF you have followed all the previous parts your alt should now have piety unlocked and 100 QP and 85+ combat and 75 Magic

steps.title: Having DS2 completed on an alt …
steps.text: Having DS2 completed on an alt has many benefits: Rune Dragons 1.5m gp/h, Vorkath 2-3m gp/h, Ferocious gloves, avas assembler, Wrath RC 1m+ gp/h

steps.title: But we still need to get …
steps.text: But we still need to get 100 QP more and level up some skills to meet the requirements

steps.title: DO bird house until 60 hunter …
steps.text: DO bird house until 60 hunter if you plan on doing mm2
steps.note: Bird house trapping on Fossil Island (needs Bone Voyage) - passive runs every 50 min, fastest XP to ~80; drift net at 44 if training Fishing.

steps.title: Put combat quest xp on magic …
steps.text: Put combat quest xp on magic if not lvl 75 yet OR on strength
